title: James Bible Quiz - Chapter 3
description: Ten questions on James 3: the tongue, the fire it kindles, and the wisdom that comes down from above.

questions.text: What does the text say not many of you should be?
questions.explanation: James 3:1 says: let not many of you be teachers, because teachers will receive heavier judgment.

questions.text: According to verse 2, what is the person who does not stumble in word called?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says that anyone who doesn't stumble in word is a perfect person, able to bridle the whole body also.

questions.text: What guides the great ships that are driven by fierce winds?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says the ships, though they are so big and driven by fierce winds, are guided by a very small rudder, wherever the pilot desires.

questions.text: What is the tongue called in verse 6?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says: and the tongue is a fire, which defiles the whole body.

questions.text: According to verse 8, what can nobody do?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says that nobody can tame the tongue; it is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.

questions.text: With the tongue we bless God and we curse men who are what?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says that with the tongue we bless our God and Father, and with it we curse men who are made in the image of God.

answers.text: Made in the image of God

questions.text: According to verse 12, what can a fig tree not yield?
questions.explanation: Verse 12 asks whether a fig tree can yield olives, or a vine figs, and answers that no spring yields both salt water and fresh water.

questions.text: Where does the wisdom of bitter jealousy and selfish ambition not come from?
questions.explanation: Verse 15 says that this wisdom is not that which comes down from above, but is earthly, sensual, and demonic.

questions.text: According to verse 16, what is found where jealousy and selfish ambition are?
questions.explanation: Verse 16 says that where jealousy and selfish ambition are, there is confusion and every evil deed.

questions.text: By whom is the fruit of righteousness sown in peace?
questions.explanation: Verse 18 says that the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.
